name: DBTL-Bench
description: DBTL-Bench is a deterministic design-then-test benchmark for measuring how a harness changes a frozen language-model agent's ability to satisfy a costly design verdict. It covers three synthetic-biology design families: regulatory elements (promoter and ribosome-binding site), genetic circuits (repressor-to-gate assignment), and metabolic pathways (reaction knockouts). This record contains the reference data, the summary results and the figure source data behind the JLU-CP 2026 study, together with acquisition manifests, model and endpoint disclosure, and download instructions for third-party dependencies. Third-party payloads are not redistributed: Cello-UCF is use-only, iML1515 is under a BiGG non-commercial research licence, and several other resources are large enough that users should fetch them from the canonical source. See external/MANIFEST.tsv and external/DOWNLOAD.md. Team-generated data are licensed CC BY 4.0. The software that runs the benchmark is maintained separately at https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/jlu-cp/dbtl-bench.
